n: NASA JPL Mission to Mars Unit
t: A free set of Mars lessons for grades K to 9 with some coding and robotics.
steps: Find the Mission to Mars unit on the NASA JPL Education site.
Read the six stages from Learn About Mars to Surface Operations.
Choose two or three lessons that fit your grade.
Gather the materials listed on each lesson page.
Try the Scratch lesson yourself before class.
Check which lessons need a rover or microcontrollers.
Run the first lesson with students.
